descriptions.preferred: 庆典由美国俄勒冈州巴克霍兹苗圃的苗圃主泰隆 ·巴克霍兹于 2007 年在紫精灵的幼苗中选育的一个品种 , 属于脉叶品种。春天新叶为粉紫色，并带有紫色的脉纹，随着时间推移，变暗为深青铜紫色和深色叶脉形成鲜明对比，新老叶色彩层叠，观赏性强，秋天为紫红色。成年树高约 2-3 米。

products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Celebration' 'Celebration' Pink Reticulated Variegated Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Celebration' leafs out as a vibrant pink-purple with reticulated ghost-like variegation. In the south, by early summer this variegation turns creamy with dark defined reticulated veins in the leaf. The new growth returns to the vibrant pink-purple. Fall color is an intense fuchsia red.
